html:
Kaysone Phomvihane led the Lao People's Revolutionary Party and was the first prime minister of the Lao People's Democratic Republic, from 1975 to 1991, then its president until his death in 1992.

Half Vietnamese, he studied in Hanoi and joined the communist movement under Ho Chi Minh. He led the Pathet Lao from caves in the northeast through the civil war.

In power he sent thousands of former officials to re-education camps and collectivised farming, which failed. From 1986 he opened the economy under a New Economic Mechanism, like Vietnam's Đổi Mới. His party still rules Laos alone.
